info.name: B2B Warehouse floor (المستودع)
info.description:
# B2B Warehouse floor (المستودع)

Generated **2026-11-18** from `route:list` + catalog. Live routes only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Requests | **33** |
| Environment | `docs/api/environments/warehouse-desktop.postman_environment.json` |
| X-Client | `warehouse-web` |
| Seed | php artisan warehouse:register-device … then device_token + PIN |

Import this file **and** the matching environment. `baseUrl` is the host only (no `/api/v1`).
Each request ships saved **Examples** (success + catalog error codes) under the Examples tab.
Do not mix tokens across platform / channel / warehouse / app collections.

Contract briefs: `docs/DocsLast/warehouse.md` · order flow: `docs/DocsLast/order-flow.md`

Regenerate: `php docs/api/generate-dashboard-postman.php`

item.name: 00. Auth
item.description:
Surface: **warehouse** · Folder: `00. Auth`

Run Auth first so `token` / `otp_id` are saved. Writes need `X-Idempotency-Key` unless the request marks exempt.
Examples under each request are catalog samples (success envelope + known error codes), not a live recording.

request.description:
**EP-WH-001** · `POST /warehouse/auth/device-login`

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | **exempt** |
| X-Client | `warehouse-web` |
| Name | دخول جهاز المستودع |

Device must be pre-registered. PIN is short.

**Example response `data`:**
```json
{
    "token": "30|warehouse_xxxxx",
    "warehouse": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "مستودع المزة"
    },
    "permissions": [
        "wh.queue.view",
        "wh.picking.execute"
    ]
}
```

**Errors:** `401` unauthenticated

request.description:
**EP-WH-063** · `POST /warehouse/stock-shortages`

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `warehouse` |
| Permission | `wh.picking.shortage` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `warehouse-web` |
| Name | توزيع نقص صنف تلقائياً |

Warehouse enters total available for the SKU once. System distributes FIFO by sub_order.created_at across open fulfillment statuses (confirmed|assigned|accepted|processing). Reduced lines await retailer EP-RT-036 (accept_partial|cancel). EP-WH-014 remains for a single picking-list line.

**Example response `data`:**
```json
{
    "allocation_id": 501,
    "product_id": 880,
    "variant_id": null,
    "qty_available": 12,
    "lines": [
        {
            "sub_order_id": 9001,
            "sub_order_line_id": 1,
            "qty_requested": 10,
            "qty_allocated": 10,
            "status": "awaiting_retailer"
        },
        {
            "sub_order_id": 9002,
            "sub_order_line_id": 2,
            "qty_requested": 10,
            "qty_allocated": 2,
            "status": "awaiting_retailer"
        }
    ]
}
```

**Errors:** `422` validation_failed

request.description:
**EP-WH-061** · `POST /warehouse/sub-orders/{id}/confirm`

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `warehouse` |
| Permission | `wh.orders.confirm` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `warehouse-web` |
| Name | تأكيد طلب من المستودع |

Allowed only when channel settings.order_approver=warehouse. Reserves stock and creates picking list (same as EP-SC-062). Rep-sourced orders auto-assign to the submitting rep after confirm.

**Example response `data`:**
```json
{
    "status": "confirmed",
    "picking_list_id": 301
}
```

**Errors:** `409` illegal_transition · `423` credit_limit_exceeded

request.description:
**EP-WH-050** · `GET /warehouse/reports/productivity`

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `warehouse` |
| Permission | `wh.reports.view` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `warehouse-web` |
| Name | تقرير إنتاجية المستودع |

Scoped to the device warehouse. pick_accuracy_bps is integer basis points at 10^4 (1188/1200 = 9900). Empty range → zeros and empty daily[]. date_from/date_to inclusive Asia/Damascus calendar days; default last 7 days.
